jobs.description:
Deine Aufgaben
• Gemeinsam mit unserem interdisziplinären Team behandelst du Patientinnen und Patienten mit subakuten psychischen und sozialen Problemen im tagesklinischen Setting.
• Nach einer fundierten Einarbeitung leitest du Gruppentherapien und begleitest die Patientinnen und Patienten durch den strukturierten Therapieprozess.
• Als Pflegefachperson gestaltest du das Tagesprogramm, beobachtest und analysierst die Gruppendynamik und dokumentierst den Behandlungsverlauf in unserem Krankenhausinformationssystem.
• In deinem abwechslungsreichen Arbeitsalltag begegnest du dem gesamten Spektrum psychiatrischer Krankheitsbilder und arbeitest eng mit unserem Behandlungsteam aus Medizin, Psychologie, Pflege und Therapie zusammen.
• An unserem Standort in Uznach nimmst du aktiv an Rapporten, Fallbesprechungen und Fortbildungen teil und pflegst den stetigen Austausch mit den anderen Behandelnden.
• Zusammen mit deinen Kolleginnen und Kollegen engagierst du dich in der Öffentlichkeitsarbeit und repräsentierst die Psychiatrie St.Gallen professionell und sympathisch nach aussen. Dein Profil
• Du verfügst über eine abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Pflegefachperson HF/FH und hast idealerweise bereits Berufserfahrung in der Psychiatrie gesammelt (SRK-Anerkennung oder positiver SRK-PreCheck bei ausländischen Diplomen erforderlich).
• Dein Interesse gilt der tagesklinischen, interdisziplinären Behandlung, die sich an den Bedürfnissen der Patientinnen und Patienten sowie ihres Umfelds orientiert.
• Das Planen und Leiten von Gruppentherapien bereitet dir Freude und der wertschätzende Austausch mit Patientinnen und Patienten liegt dir.
• Es macht dir Spass, dein Fachwissen kontinuierlich zu erweitern, neue Entwicklungen in der Pflege aufzugreifen und diese in deinen Arbeitsalltag zu integrieren.
• Du arbeitest selbstständig, bist offen für Neues und schätzt die Zusammenarbeit in einem motivierten und engagierten Team. descriptionByLocale.it:
I tuoi compiti
• Insieme al nostro team interdisciplinare, tratterai i pazienti con problemi psicologici e sociali subacuti nell'ambiente clinico quotidiano.
• Dopo una conoscenza ben fondata, si conducono terapie di gruppo e accompagnano i pazienti attraverso il processo di terapia strutturata.
• Come infermiera, progetta il programma giornaliero, osserva e analizza le dinamiche di gruppo e documenta il corso di trattamento nel nostro sistema informativo ospedaliero.
• Nel vostro vario lavoro quotidiano, incontrerete l'intero spettro di malattie psichiatriche e lavorerete a stretto contatto con il nostro team di trattamento da medicina, psicologia, cura e terapia.
• Nella nostra posizione a Uznach, si partecipa attivamente a rapporti, discussioni di casi e corsi di formazione e mantenere uno scambio costante con altri professionisti.
• Insieme ai vostri colleghi, siete coinvolti nel lavoro di pubbliche relazioni e rappresentate la psichiatria St.Gallen professionalmente e simpaticamente. Il tuo profilo
• Hai completato la formazione come infermiera HF/FH e idealmente hanno già acquisito esperienza professionale in psichiatria (riconoscimento RSK o positivo SRK PreCheck richiesto per i diplomi stranieri).
• Il vostro interesse è nel trattamento clinico, interdisciplinare quotidiano, che si basa sulle esigenze dei pazienti e del loro ambiente.
• Pianificazione e terapie di gruppo leader ti dà piacere e lo scambio apprezzativo con i pazienti è tuo.
• Vi piace espandere continuamente la vostra esperienza, prendendo nuovi sviluppi nella cura e integrandoli nel vostro lavoro quotidiano.
• Lavori in modo indipendente, sei aperto a nuove cose e apprezzi lavorare insieme in un team motivato e impegnato. Con circa 1.400 dipendenti, forniamo trattamenti psichiatrici accessibili, personali ed efficaci e cure per gli adulti nei cantoni di St.Gallen e Appenzell Ausserrhoden così come nel Principato del Liechtenstein nelle nostre nove sedi aziendali. Siamo sulla strada digitalmente e siamo impegnati alla sostenibilità, quindi non vediamo l'ora della vostra applicazione online tramite la nostra homepage. Non appena la vostra domanda è stata ricevuta da noi online, riceverete una conferma della ricevuta via e-mail. Siamo lieti di conoscervi sulla base del vostro dossier e verificare se le vostre qualifiche, le vostre abilità e voi come persona si adattano alla posizione pubblicizzata e la psichiatria St.Gallen. Allora ti contatteremo. Durante un'intervista personale ci conosceremo e imparerete di più sulla psichiatria St.Gallen, la posizione pubblicizzata e le sfide. Nel secondo round vorremmo ottenere un'immagine ancora migliore di voi e scoprire insieme a voi se ci adattiamo insieme. Hai anche l'opportunità di conoscere la tua squadra futura. Riceverete una conferma telefonica da noi se decidiamo per voi dopo la seconda intervista e vi chiediamo se siete ancora convinti di noi. Se siamo d'accordo, prepareremo il tuo contratto. Nei giorni seguenti ti invieremo il contratto per posta in doppio. Il contratto ti fornisce anche informazioni rilevanti sul tuo lavoro. Tra l'accettazione del lavoro e il primo giorno lavorativo, l'utente come nuovo dipendente può già accedere a informazioni interne rilevanti. Così si può ottenere un quadro differenziato della società e già prepararsi per il lavoro. Il primo giorno ci si può aspettare un onboarding nel vostro nuovo team e con altri colleghi. È impostato sul nuovo posto di lavoro e ottenere una panoramica delle vostre prossime attività. Si ottiene anche il vostro piano di introduzione individuale, che vi aiuta a trovare il vostro senso intorno rapidamente.

descriptionByLocale.en:
Your tasks
• Together with our interdisciplinary team, you will treat patients with subacute psychological and social problems in the daily clinical setting.
• After a well-founded familiarization, you lead group therapies and accompany the patients through the structured therapy process.
• As a nurse, you design the daily program, observe and analyze the group dynamics and document the course of treatment in our hospital information system.
• In your varied everyday work, you will encounter the entire spectrum of psychiatric diseases and work closely with our treatment team from medicine, psychology, care and therapy.
• At our location in Uznach, you actively participate in rapports, case discussions and training courses and maintain a constant exchange with other practitioners.
• Together with your colleagues, you are involved in public relations work and represent the psychiatry St.Gallen professionally and sympathetically. Your profile
• You have completed training as a nurse HF/FH and ideally have already gained professional experience in psychiatry (SRK recognition or positive SRK PreCheck required for foreign diplomas).
• Your interest is in day-to-day clinical, interdisciplinary treatment, which is based on the needs of patients and their environment.
• Planning and leading group therapies gives you pleasure and the appreciative exchange with patients is yours.
• You enjoy continuously expanding your expertise, taking up new developments in care and integrating them into your everyday work.
• You work independently, are open to new things and appreciate working together in a motivated and committed team. With around 1,400 employees, we provide accessible, personal and effective psychiatric treatments and care for adults in the cantons of St.Gallen and Appenzell Ausserrhoden as well as in the Principality of Liechtenstein at our nine company locations. We are on the road digitally and are committed to sustainability, so we look forward to your online application via our homepage. As soon as your application has been received by us online, you will receive a confirmation of receipt by e-mail. We are happy to get to know you based on your dossier and check whether your qualifications, skills and you as a person fit the advertised position and the psychiatry St.Gallen. Then we will contact you. During a personal interview we get to know each other and you will learn more about the psychiatry St.Gallen, the advertised position and the challenges. In the second round we would like to get an even better picture of you and find out together with you whether we fit together. You also get the opportunity to get to know your future team. You will receive a telephone confirmation from us if we decide for you after the second interview and ask you if you are still convinced of us. If we agree, we will draw up your contract. In the following days we will send you the contract by post in double. The contract also provides you with relevant information about your employment. Between the acceptance of the job and the first working day, you as a new employee can already access relevant internal information. So you can get a differentiated picture of the company and already prepare for the job. On the first day you can expect an onboarding in your new team and with other colleagues. You set up at the new workplace and get an overview of your next tasks. You also get your individual introduction plan, which helps you to find your way around quickly.

• Together with our interdisciplinary team, you will treat patients with subacute psychological and social problems in the daily clinical setting.

• As a nurse, you design the daily program, observe and analyze the group dynamics and document the course of treatment in our hospital information system.
• In your varied everyday work, you will encounter the entire spectrum of psychiatric diseases and work closely with our treatment team from medicine, psychology, care and therapy.
• At our location in Uznach, you actively participate in rapports, case discussions and training courses and maintain a constant exchange with other practitioners.
• Together with your colleagues, you are involved in public relations work and represent the psychiatry St.Gallen professionally and sympathetically.

• Planning and leading group therapies gives you pleasure and the appreciative exchange with patients is yours.
• You enjoy continuously expanding your expertise, taking up new developments in care and integrating them into your everyday work.
• You work independently, are open to new things and appreciate working together in a motivated and committed team.

Vos tâches
• En collaboration avec notre équipe interdisciplinaire, vous traiterez les patients présentant des problèmes psychologiques et sociaux subaigus dans le cadre clinique quotidien.
• Après une familiarisation bien fondée, vous dirigez des thérapies de groupe et accompagnez les patients dans le processus de thérapie structurée.
• En tant qu'infirmière, vous concevez le programme quotidien, observez et analysez la dynamique de groupe et documentez le déroulement du traitement dans notre système d'information hospitalier.
• Dans votre travail quotidien varié, vous rencontrerez tout le spectre des maladies psychiatriques et travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec notre équipe de traitement de la médecine, de la psychologie, des soins et de la thérapie.
• Sur notre site d'Uznach, vous participez activement à des rapports, à des discussions de cas et à des cours de formation et maintenez un échange constant avec d'autres praticiens.
• Avec vos collègues, vous participez au travail de relations publiques et représentez la psychiatrie St.Gallen de manière professionnelle et sympathique. Votre profil
• Vous avez suivi une formation en tant qu'infirmière HF/FH et, idéalement, vous avez déjà acquis une expérience professionnelle en psychiatrie (reconnaissance SRK ou précontrôle SRK positif requis pour les diplômes étrangers).
• Vous vous intéressez au traitement clinique interdisciplinaire quotidien, qui est basé sur les besoins des patients et leur environnement.
• La planification et les thérapies de groupe vous donnent plaisir et l'échange d'appréciation avec les patients est le vôtre.
• Vous appréciez l'élargissement continu de votre expertise, l'adoption de nouveaux développements en matière de soins et leur intégration dans votre travail quotidien.
• Vous travaillez de manière indépendante, êtes ouvert à de nouvelles choses et appréciez de travailler ensemble dans une équipe motivée et engagée. Nous sommes heureux de vous connaître sur la base de votre dossier et de vérifier si vos qualifications, compétences et vous en tant que personne correspondent au poste annoncé et à la psychiatrie St.Gallen. Alors nous vous contacterons. Lors d'une entrevue personnelle, nous apprenons à nous connaître et vous en apprendrez plus sur la psychiatrie St.Gallen, le poste annoncé et les défis. Au deuxième tour, nous aimerions avoir une meilleure image de vous et découvrir avec vous si nous nous marions. Vous avez également l'occasion de connaître votre future équipe. Vous recevrez une confirmation téléphonique de notre part si nous décidons pour vous après la deuxième entrevue et vous demandons si vous êtes toujours convaincu de nous. Si nous sommes d'accord, nous établirons votre contrat. Dans les jours suivants, nous vous enverrons le contrat par la poste en double. Le contrat vous fournit également des informations pertinentes sur votre emploi. Entre l'acceptation de l'emploi et le premier jour ouvrable, vous en tant que nouvel employé pouvez déjà accéder aux informations internes pertinentes. Ainsi, vous pouvez obtenir une image différenciée de l'entreprise et déjà préparer pour le travail. Le premier jour, vous pouvez vous attendre à être embarqué dans votre nouvelle équipe et avec d'autres collègues. Vous vous installez sur le nouveau lieu de travail et obtenez un aperçu de vos prochaines tâches. Vous obtenez également votre plan d'introduction individuel, ce qui vous aide à trouver votre chemin rapidement.

• Sosterrai il nostro team nell'elaborazione delle transazioni di pagamento e acquisirai approfondimenti sui processi finanziari rilevanti dell'amministrazione dei pazienti.

• Siete disponibili per uno stage di 6-12 mesi e godetevi la responsabilità e l'apprendimento di nuove cose.

Your tasks
• You will support our team in processing payment transactions and gain in-depth insights into the financially relevant processes of patient administration.
• You take over the collection and processing of the payment files and take part in the processing of refunds as well as the processing of double and individual payments.
• You check refunds, document the corresponding justifications and support the subsequent processing and booking in cooperation with the accounting.
• You will gain insights into outpatient and day-to-day clinical pricing as well as into performance integration and help ensure correct performance recording.
• You work in invoicing, processing of rejections, dunning runs and debtor management.
• You will maintain system-relevant information in our Opale ERP system, support regular drug updates and help optimize administrative processes and other patient management projects. Your profile
• You will complete a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Business Administration, Accounting & Finance, Economics, Health Economics or a comparable degree programme.
• You are interested in business and administrative processes in the healthcare sector and would like to gain practical experience in the financial and patient administration sector.
• Structured work, analytical thinking, personal responsibility and a careful and reliable way of working are among your strengths.
• You like to work in a team, bring a quick comprehension and have a high number affinity.
• You have a good knowledge of the common MS Office applications, especially Excel.
• You are available for an internship of 6 to 12 months and enjoy taking responsibility and learning new things.

Deine Aufgaben
• Du unterstützt unser Team bei der Abwicklung des Zahlungsverkehrs und erhältst vertiefte Einblicke in die finanzrelevanten Prozesse der Patientenadministration.
• Du übernimmst die Abholung und Verarbeitung der Zahlungsdateien und wirkst bei der Bearbeitung von Rückzahlungen sowie der Abwicklung von Doppel- und Einzelzahlungen mit.
• Du prüfst Rückzahlungen, dokumentierst die entsprechenden Begründungen und unterstützt bei der anschliessenden Verarbeitung und Verbuchung in Zusammenarbeit mit dem Accounting.
• Du erhältst Einblicke in die ambulante und tagesklinische Tarifierung sowie in die Leistungsintegration und trägst zur Sicherstellung einer korrekten Leistungserfassung bei.
• Du arbeitest bei der Fakturation, der Bearbeitung von Rückweisungen, Mahnläufen und der Debitorenbewirtschaftung mit.
• Du pflegst systemrelevante Informationen in unserem ERP-System Opale, unterstützt bei regelmässigen Medikamentenupdates und wirkst bei der Optimierung administrativer Prozesse sowie bei weiteren Projekten im Patientenmanagement mit. Dein Profil
• Du absolvierst ein Bachelor- oder Masterstudium in Betriebswirtschaftslehre, Accounting & Finance, Wirtschaftswissenschaften, Gesundheitsökonomie oder einem vergleichbaren Studiengang.
